title: A PRAYER OF PRAISE
WHEN WEARY
poster: PRAISE THE LORD O MY SOUL
WHILE I LIVE I WILL SING
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: golden light over calm lake hills
peaceful river flowing through trees golden hour
warm sunlight filtering through mountain forest
misty river landscape early morning glow

scenes.a: Your hands feel empty after this long day.
Yet even here, your heart can turn toward heaven.
The Psalmist writes, Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
Father, when our strength falters and answers seem slow, remind us that our praise belongs to You in every season.
We thank You for breath, for grace, and for Your unending love that sustains our souls today.
Hear our grateful prayer, Amen. Your hands feel empty after this long day.
